page.layout: One block of running text at full width under the running head; in the right margin beside the first lines, a marginal note "Ergo" with a catchword-like "Cap." below it, both as notes.

main_text.p: summo eoque ineffabili amore complectantur et in æternis delitijs habeant. Atque ita hoc perpetui visus respectu charitas est maior fide et spe. iErgopræstat ijs, vtcunque vno nomine inferior sit. Neque enim charitas sed fides totius humanæ sanctitatis basis et fundamentum et nunc est et in futuro sæculo ita manebit. Ergo hæc præstantia non est absoluta.Cap.

page.notes: The running head and heading are set as printed: "1. Ad Corinthios" at top centre and "Cap. 15" at top right. The marginal notes "Ergo" and "Cap." are in the right margin. Some words near the line ends are damaged by the binding shadow; "i-" at the end of a line is a broken word completed as "præstat" on the next line. The word "Ergo" at the start of the last line is printed in black letter and is shown as such. Some letters are blurred and may be misread.
